newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to veer downwards, support 102.22.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to veer downwards, support 102.22.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE will show slight negative action on Monday, but any downmove will be temporary, technical analysts said.
"There is support at 102.29/102.22," said Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.
"We need to see a corrective base before pushing again to the upside," he added.

The 102.29 level is a 38 percent retracement of last week's rally from the high on July 1 of 101.92 to the high on July 4 of 102.52. The 102.22 level is a 50 percent retracement of the same move. September Bunds were 0.07 higher at 102.54 at 0715 GMT.
Wilkin found resistance close to current levels at 102.59, a high on weekly continuation charts for the week of May 18.
Brenda Sullivan and Elizabeth Miller of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London also found resistance at 102.59.
"Daily stochastics remain supportive...and a test of 102.59 is favoured this week," they said in a research note.
Further resistance comes in at 102.86, the 76.4 retracement of the mid-February to early April slide, Sullivan and Miller said.
Daily continuation charts show Bunds declined from a high of 104.04 on February 18 to a low of 99.05 on April 3.
Wilkin found further barriers on the upside at Fibonacci projection targets of 102.75 and 102.80.
To the downside, the psychological 102.00 level and last Monday's high of 101.92 provided support, he added.
December Euromarks were trading at 96.77 at 0854 GMT, unchanged from Friday's close.
